result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Analyze specific Dataverse Artifacts in the current Environment

USAGE:
    dgtp analyze [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    dgtp analyze noactivelayer --inline solution1,solution2
    dgtp analyze activelayer --inline solution1,solution2
    dgtp analyze toplayer --inline solution1,solution2

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                Prints help information                           
        --no-telemetry        Disable telemetry for this invocation             
        --inline                                                                
        --note-patches                                                          
        --generate-report                                                       
        --generate-summary                                                      
    -c, --config              Full path to the config file, e.g.                
                              C:\temp\config.json                               

COMMANDS:
    entityallassets        Scans the specified solutions for entities containing
                           with assets                                          
    noactivelayer          Scans the specified (unmanaged) solutions for        
                           components without active layer                      
    redundantcomponents    Scans for components that are in multiple of the     
                           specified solutions                                  
    redundantpatches       Scans for patch solutions that are not longer needed 
                           because all contained elements are not top-layer     
                           anymore                                              
    activelayer            Scans the specified (managed) solutions for          
                           components with active layer                         
    toplayer               Scans the specified (managed) solutions for          
                           components where solution is not top layer
